Jagannath Temple Assets Include Over ₹1900 Crore in Bank Accounts

The Jagannath Temple in Puri, Odisha, has assets totaling approximately ₹1,912 crore deposited in its bank accounts. Additionally, the temple owns 60,821 acres of land across the country. The temple's 'Ratna Bhandar' (treasure trove) also contains gold and diamond jewelry. This information was released by the temple administration.
